method: Stream all174 retained Git blob bodies through stdlib SHA256 without parsing tensor/checkpoint/model content. Each entry pins exact path/mode/blob/bytes/SHA at every matching retained local tip; source capsule filename SHA is checked. Compare loose blobs across both full pinned main trees; no compressed/archive/store body search performed.
remote_reachability: All60 advertised workspace and19 package heads/tags have locally available commit graphs; none of the9 divergent tips is an ancestor of any current advertised origin ref. Keep local refs, do not invent GitHub commit links. Server-retained unreachable objects are not asserted.
review_order: P1: eight unrepresented release cards/documentation files establish owner/license/provenance context.
P2: fourteen unrepresented source capsules compared with newer main owner APIs; no canonical restoration or model import.
P3: fifty-one unrepresented checkpoint/control JSONs require exact compressed/archive/store membership and tensor-owner lineage review; no loads/default activation.
101 exact bodies already retained elsewhere on main (99 source capsules, one release document and the release manifest) serve as custody references; avoid duplicate imports.
